title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager - Brand & CRM North West Online Retailer Salary £45k - £55k + Benefits

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a commercially minded Marketing Manager to join an established, growing ecommerce business.

This is a hands-on, varied role combining brand development, CRM, product marketing and multi-channel campaign delivery. The successful candidate will take ownership of customer engagement, retention and brand consistency, creating compelling campaigns that drive measurable commercial results.

The Marketing Manager will work closely with senior leadership, balancing creative thinking with a data-led approach to marketing.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver engaging product marketing campaigns across digital channels.
- Own CRM and email marketing, including segmentation, automation and customer lifecycle journeys.
- Drive customer retention, repeat purchase and lifetime value.
- Maintain consistent brand positioning, messaging and creative standards.
- Manage campaign content, creative briefs and external partners.
- Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour and commercial KPIs.
- Identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion and revenue.
- Manage marketing budgets and maximise return on investment.

About You
- Proven experience as a Marketing Manager or Senior Marketing Executive within ecommerce, retail or a consumer brand.
- Strong hands-on CRM and email marketing experience.
- Experience developing and delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- A strong understanding of brand marketing, customer engagement and product storytelling.
- Commercially driven, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Confident managing creative content, external partners and multiple priorities.
- A proactive, organised individual who enjoys both strategy and hands-on delivery.

This Marketing Manager opportunity offers genuine ownership, variety and the chance to make a measurable impact within a growing business.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Paid Social Specialist
description:
PAID SOCIAL SPECIALIST

Ready to take ownership of a rapidly growing Paid Social offering and make a real impact?
- Must be able to commute to Chester 2-3 days a week
- Salary up to £38k DOE
- Exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing, ambitious digital marketing agency
- Take ownership of Paid Social strategy across a portfolio of exciting client accounts
- Work across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Pinterest
- Genuine opportunity to shape the future of Paid Social, influence creative strategy and drive measurable growth
- Open to agency or in-house background

ABOUT THE CLIENT

We're working with an ambitious, forward thinking digital marketing agency that's experiencing some seriously exciting growth. Their Paid Social portfolio has tripled in size over the last 18 months, and they're now looking for a talented Paid Social Media Specialist to help take things to the next level.

This isn't a role where you'll simply be managing campaigns and reporting on results. You'll have the freedom to bring fresh ideas to the table, challenge existing strategies and play a key part in shaping how Paid Social is delivered across the agency.

If you're someone who loves combining creative thinking with performance data and wants genuine ownership of your work, this could be a brilliant next step.

THE BENEFITS
- Join a thriving agency with a rapidly expanding Paid Social offering
- Real ownership and autonomy over strategy, campaigns and performance
- Opportunity to work with an in-house design and motion team
- Exposure to multiple advertising platforms and exciting client projects
- Scope to influence best practices, introduce new ideas and develop your expertise
- Collaborative environment where creativity, innovation and results are genuinely valued

THE PAID SOCIAL MEDIA SPECIALIST ROLE

As a Paid Social Media Specialist, you'll be at the heart of an exciting period of growth, taking ownership of Paid Social campaigns from initial strategy through to execution, optimisation and reporting.

You'll be the go to expert for Paid Social, working closely with clients and creative teams to build campaigns that don't just look great, but deliver meaningful commercial results.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Own Paid Social campaigns end-to-end - Manage and optimise Meta advertising accounts, from audience strategy and campaign builds through to reporting and performance analysis
- Drive creative innovation - Collaborate with design and motion teams to develop engaging UGC-style content, scroll-stopping adverts and conversion-focused creative
- Test, learn and scale - Lead creative testing, audience experimentation and incrementality testing to uncover new opportunities for growth
- Explore new platforms - Identify opportunities across TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Pinterest, using performance data to guide investment
- Be the Paid Social expert - Take a leading role in client meetings, confidently presenting results, explaining strategies and recommending improvements
- Shape the bigger picture - Work alongside PPC and SEO specialists to ensure Paid Social contributes to wider digital marketing objectives

PAID SOCIAL MEDIA SPECIALIST ESSENTIAL SKILLS

We're looking for someone who's passionate about Paid Social, commercially minded and excited by the opportunity to make their mark.

You'll ideally bring:
- 2+ years experience managing Paid Social campaigns within an agency or in-house environment
- Strong hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager, alongside at least one additional advertising platform
- A solid understanding of creative testing, audience targeting and campaign optimisation
- Confidence analysing performance data and translating insights into actionable recommendations
- An understanding of how Paid Social works alongside PPC, SEO and wider digital marketing strategies
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to build strong client relationships
- A creative mindset combined with a genuine passion for delivering measurable results

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who's ready to move beyond simply managing campaigns and become a key voice in a growing Paid Social function.

If you're passionate about Paid Social, love getting stuck into the creative side of performance marketing and want to see the impact of your ideas, we'd love to hear from you.

TO BE CONSIDERED

title: Part-time Marketing Assistant/Analyst
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Part-time Marketing Assistant/Analyst, you will help with the day-to-day delivery of marketing activity for an Industrial / Manufacturing organisation. You will keep marketing tasks organised and provide clear analysis that helps colleagues make informed decisions.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Industrial / Manufacturing sector.

Description
- Coordinate the end-to-end administration of product and item data activities, including the creation, maintenance, and amendment of records across internal systems.
- Manage incoming requests, ensuring all required information and supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and submitted in line with established processes.
- Monitor workflow progress, track approvals, and proactively follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of activities.
- Liaise with internal teams to resolve data, process, or documentation issues that may impact delivery timelines.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with business procedures, quality standards, and data governance requirements.
- Support the coordination of projects and operational activities by tracking actions, deadlines, and key deliverables.
- Follow up with contributors to ensure agreed tasks, documentation, and inputs are completed within required timescales.
- Maintain visibility of outstanding actions, risks, and dependencies, helping to keep workstreams organised and progressing efficiently.
- Provide administrative and coordination support across multiple projects and business initiatives as required.
- Demonstrate strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and a proactive approach to delivering accurate and efficient outcomes.

Profile

A successful Part-time Marketing Assistant/Analyst should have:
- Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, workflows, and deadlines simultaneously.
- Excellent attention to detail, ensuring data, documentation, and records are maintained accurately and consistently.
- Experience working with business systems and databases, ideally including ERP platforms such as SAP or similar enterprise systems.
- Confident managing administrative processes and following structured procedures to ensure activities are completed efficiently and compliantly.
- Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across different teams and departments.
- Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and see them through to successful completion.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to gather information, provide updates, and collaborate with colleagues at all levels.
- Ability to prioritise workloads, follow up on actions, and ensure deadlines are met in a fast-paced environment.
- A methodical and dependable approach, with a commitment to maintaining high standards of accuracy and service delivery.
- Previous experience in an administrative, operations, project coordination, product support, data management, or business support role would be advantageous.
- Experience supporting cross-functional projects, business change initiatives, or process improvement activities would be beneficial.
- Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.

Job Offer
- Ongoing Temporary contract.
- Hourly pay of £16.46 + Holiday Pay.
- Part-time, 20 hours per week Marketing Assistant/Analyst.
- Remote working position.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.
